content: smoltcp latest v0.14.0 (docs.rs 2026-09/10): no_std TCP/IP stack for bare-metal; MSRV stable Rust 1.91 (satisfied by r9 nightly-2026-01-30); default-features=false then opt into medium-ethernet + proto-ipv4 (+proto-dhcpv4 for DHCP client) + socket-tcp/socket-udp/socket-icmp (+socket-dhcpv4); alloc feature = managed/alloc; heap-free capable; wire via custom phy Device impl over the virtio-net rx/tx buffers. Feature compile_error guards: socket feature requires at least one socket-* and one medium-*.
